question: How many years will the probe window last in this process?

turn.question: How many years will the probe window last in this process?

claims.text: The supplied sources do not state any lifetime, wear rate or service interval for a probe window in a feed-frame powder process, so no figure can be given here.
Window wear in a feed frame will depend on abrasive contact with the flowing powder, cleaning frequency and the window material chosen, none of which are characterised in the supplied material.
A practical way to bound the lifetime is to inspect the probe window on a fixed schedule during the planned feed-frame trial and record any scratching, coating or signal drift.

answer.next_step: Add a window-condition check (visual inspection plus a reference-standard scan before and after each trial run) to the feed-frame trial plan, so wear rate and cleaning needs are measured on your own blend rather than estimated.
